research.facts:
D11 Bond Measure 4A — $775M on the November Ballot
**Sources:**
- krdo.com (Oct 9, 2026) — news coverage of ballot measure details
- kktv.com — D11 bond coverage
- gazette.com (Oct 6, 2026) — editorial endorsement
- d11.org — official district bond information
**Verified Facts:**
- Bond amount: $775 million
- Ballot date: November 3, 2026
- Board vote: 6-1 on August 5, 2026
- Cost to homeowners: ~$260/year (~$6.50/month per $100,000 of assessed property value)
- Uses: safety/security upgrades, HVAC and air filtration replacement, asbestos and lead pipe removal, CTE program renovations, classroom modernization, library renovations
- Bond also prepays existing lease-purchase obligations (frees up MLO for teacher pay)
- Independent citizens' oversight committee required by the measure

CPSC Recalls Two Baby Bath Seat Models
**Sources:**
- cpsc.gov — official recall pages for both products
- consumeraffairs.com (Oct 9, 2026 roundup) — compiled recall summary
**Verified Facts:**
- YCXXKJ Baby Bath Seats: sold on Amazon by BenTalk; recall reason: drowning and entrapment risk; violates mandatory federal safety standard
- ONTHEWEI bath seats: recall date Oct 8, 2026; >2,000 units sold on Amazon; hazard: unstable, tips over, drowning risk; 0 reported injuries
- Both: stop use immediately, follow CPSC remedy instructions

research.facts:
BabyBond Retractable Safety Gate Recall
**Sources:**
- cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/Infant-Innovations-dba-BabyBond (official CPSC recall page)
**Verified Facts:**
- Official recall number: #26-168
- Recall issued: January 8, 2026
- Company: Infant Innovations LLC dba BabyBond, Sheridan, WY
- Units recalled: approximately 280
- Product: retractable mesh safety gate, model SH20.006DB
- Colors: black, gray, white mesh
- Dimensions: 33 inches high, adjustable width up to 55 inches
- Hazard: gap between gate bottom and floor large enough for child's torso — entrapment risk
- Sale location: Target.com
- Sale period: November 2024 through October 2025
- Price: approximately $50
- Reported incidents: none
- Remedy: stop use; return to any Target store for full refund (no receipt needed)
